# Cleric · Mirrored HUD

A ready-to-import Cleric layout, built in Aurion's editor. Player health is on the left,
the target is on the right, and skills, mana and stamina sit between them.

![Cleric HUD during combat](assets/hud/combat.gif)

Recorded in AION 2: target health drops as damage lands, cooldowns count down, and recent
skills travel along the history strip below the main HUD.

## Import into Aurion

1. Open Aurion's editor → **Interfaces** → **Import**.
2. Copy the entire string below, starting with \!AURION:1!, and paste it into the import field.
3. Check the profile preview, choose **Add**, and save with **Ctrl+S**.

<details>
<summary>Copy the import string</summary>

```text
!AURION:1!
```

</details>

You can also [open the import file](assets/hud/cleric-mirrored-hud.txt) and load the downloaded
file through **Import → From file**. If you already have this profile, import a copy to keep
your existing layout.

## What's included

- Player and target health, buffs, debuffs, and cast bars.
- Mana, stamina, main and utility skills, cooldowns, and chain steps.
- A strip of your recent skill uses, moving and fading over eight seconds.
- Party frames with health, mana, effects, and periodic healing forecasts.

### Healing

![Health changes and healing forecast](assets/hud/healing.gif)

Recorded in AION 2. The health bar shows incoming periodic healing; the striped region
marks the part that would exceed maximum health. This is a forecast, not extra healing
added to the combat journal.

### Party

![Animated party frames](assets/hud/party.gif)

Party frames shown with simulated values using the same HUD components. Health, mana,
and healing forecasts change during the preview.

## Make it yours

The layout uses a **3440 × 1440** base resolution, automatic scaling, and **90%** manual
scale. Adjust the scale under **Information → HUD scale**, then move groups in the editor
to suit your screen. Party frames appear when party data is available.

All elements, triggers, conditions, colors, and positions are editable. English and Russian
profile translations are included. The import contains only the interface; application
settings and combat history stay local to you.
